title: Hybrid LLM-Deterministic Pipelines for Enterprise-Scale Code Migration at Bloomberg
title_zh: 彭博企业级代码迁移的混合LLM-确定性流水线

paragraphs.en: 彭博分享混合LLM-确定性代码迁移流水线经验，在数千仓库中生成2333个PR，瓶颈在于团队审查与部署成本。 Large organizations carry a long tail of infrastructure migrations that are worth doing but rarely urgent enough to compete with feature work, because each one costs significant engineering time per repository. This paper reports on our industrial experience from Automated Uplift, a multi-month initiative applying LLM-assisted migration pipelines across thousands of Bloomberg repositories. We examine two distinct production campaigns: a heterogeneous Python packaging migration (approx. 1,900 candidate repositories) and a uniform C++ build system migration (approx. 6,700 candidate repositories). Together, these campaigns generated 2,333 pull requests, resulting in 729 successful migrations. We detail our hybrid architectural solution which maximizes deterministic processing, confines the LLM to bounded file transformations within a pre-computed context, and incorporates runtime production telemetry (such as execution logs and usage traces). Our findings show that generating migrations turned out to be the easier part; the bottleneck was the cost, for owning teams, of reviewing, testing, and deploying them. These costs were lowered when changes could be verified directly in the pipeline before opening a PR (as with C++ compilation and test validation), and when the population was uniform enough for fixes to carry over from one repository to the next. We conclude by distilling our experience and findings into actionable, transferable patterns for architecting hybrid LLM-deterministic pipelines and scaling code migrations across the enterprise
paragraphs.zh: 彭博分享混合LLM-确定性代码迁移流水线经验，在数千仓库中生成2333个PR，瓶颈在于团队审查与部署成本。大型组织中存在大量长尾的基础设施迁移工作，这些工作值得做，但紧迫程度通常不足以与功能开发竞争，因为每一项迁移在每个仓库上都要花费可观的工程时间。 本文报告了我们在自动化提升（Automated Uplift）项目中的工业实践经验，这是一项历时数月的计划，在彭博的数千个仓库中应用了LLM辅助的迁移流水线。 我们考察了两个不同的生产战役：一个异构的Python打包迁移（约1900个候选仓库）和一个统一的C++构建系统迁移（约6700个候选仓库）。 这两场战役共生成了2333个拉取请求，最终完成了729次成功的迁移。 我们详细介绍了混合架构解决方案：它最大化确定性处理，将LLM限制在预先计算好的上下文中执行有边界的文件转换，并纳入运行时生产遥测数据（例如执行日志和使用轨迹）。 我们的发现表明，生成迁移结果是相对容易的部分；真正的瓶颈是拥有团队（owning teams）在审查、测试和部署这些变更时的成本。 当变更能够在打开PR之前直接在流水线中得到验证时（如C++的编译和测试验证），以及当仓库群体足够同质、使修复方案能够从一个仓库迁移到下一个仓库时，这些成本就会降低。 最后，我们将经验与发现提炼为可操作、可迁移的模式，用于构建混合LLM-确定性流水线，并在整个企业范围内扩展代码迁移。
